title: 3D Diffusion Policy: Generalizable Visuomotor Policy Learning via Simple 3D Representations
grouping: Top row: two pale lavender rounded panels with bold titles '(a) End-to-End Training' (green cylinders 'Expert Demonstrations' -> thick cyan arrow -> 'Policy' = a cyan 'Perception' trapezoid joined to a blue 'Decision' box) and '(b) Evaluation' (the same Perception + Decision pair inside a loop: a pale-green 'Environment' box on top, thick light-blue rounded arrows labelled 'Observation' up the left and 'Action' down the right). Bottom row: two dashed-outline panels zoomed out of the Perception trapezoid (light-cyan dashed outline, dashed wedge lines from the trapezoid) and the Decision box (dark-blue dashed outline), titled 'Perception: Compact 3D Representations from Point Clouds' and 'Decision: Diffusion Policy'.
shapes_depth: Flat pastel shapes, no shadows. Perception panel: a single-view point-cloud photo -> 'Crop' -> robot-only points -> 'FPS' -> points coloured by a rainbow height map -> thin vertical bars for layers (Linear cyan, LayerNorm pink, ReLU grey, 'x3') -> 'Max Pool' -> Projection bars -> a cyan 'Compact 3D Repr.' box; layer widths are given as shape labels '(3, 64, 128, 256)', '(256, 64)'. Decision panel: stacked pink 'Robot State' and cyan 'Compact 3D Repr.' tiles send 'Conditioning' arrows into a U-Net of light-blue vertical bars; small blue squares a_t^K ('Noised Action') -> a_t^K-1 -> a_t^0 ('Denoised Action') with 'Denoising x (K-1)'. Thick soft-coloured arrows in the top row, thin cyan arrows in the detail panels.
proposed_highlight: Each zoom panel's dashed outline takes the colour of the block it opens (light cyan for Perception, dark blue for Decision), so the two contributions read as close-ups of the policy drawn in the overview.
lesson: Draw the policy once as a perception trapezoid plus decision box inside an Observation -> Environment -> Action loop, then zoom each half into its own dashed panel whose outline colour matches that half.
notes: Venue not verified (remembered as RSS 2024; Semantic Scholar title lookup returned 404 and arXiv timed out): written as arXiv, year = arXiv preprint year (2403.03954). elements 'feature-map-3d' = the coloured point cloud; 'other' = the database cylinders. Photo and point-cloud renders are embedded rasters.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: visuomotor imitation learning from 3D point clouds

core.what: the two-part policy (cyan Perception trapezoid + blue Decision box) is drawn small in the top panels and opened below into two dashed zoom panels, each outlined in its parent's colour and tied to it by a dashed wedge

relations.form: dashed wedge lines run from the Perception trapezoid in (a) down to a wide light-cyan dashed panel and from the Decision box in (b) down to a narrow dark-blue dashed panel
two tinted panels on the top row, '(a) End-to-End Training' left and '(b) Evaluation' right, redraw the same Perception + Decision pair
in (b) thick soft-blue arrows form a closed rectangle: Observation up the left into Perception, Decision out the right, Action up to Environment and back
the Perception panel reads left to right as real point-cloud photo -> Crop -> FPS -> height-coloured points -> MLP bars x3 -> Max Pool -> Projection -> Compact 3D Repr.
Robot State and Compact 3D Repr. stacked as a pair at the Decision panel's left feed a horizontal 'Conditioning' bus that drops short arrows into each U-Net block
denoising is drawn as one U-Net pass from a_t^K to a_t^{K-1} then a dashed arrow labelled 'Denoising x (K-1)' to a_t^0

channels.colour: light cyan = perception (trapezoid, zoom outline, Linear bars, Compact 3D Repr.), dark blue = decision; but pink carries two meanings (LayerNorm layers and the Robot State input), and the same light cyan also fills all data arrows
channels.shape: trapezoid = encoder, rectangle = decision/action blocks, cylinders = demonstration store, thin vertical bars = layers
channels.line: thick soft arrows = data flow; dashed outlines and wedges = zoom; a grey dashed arrow carries Compact 3D Repr. across the panel boundary
channels.frame: tinted solid panels = deployment phase; dashed coloured panels = detail of one module

quality.strengths: The zoom is drawn as geometry: each dashed detail panel takes its parent's colour and a wedge points to its parent, and the detail widths follow the paper's emphasis (Perception, the contribution, is the wide one); data are drawn as data (a real point-cloud photo, cropped points, height-coloured points); the evaluation loop is a closed rectangle of short straight arrows.
quality.weaknesses: Pink means both LayerNorm and robot state, and '(a)' labels both the training panel and the point-cloud sub-step; the U-Net is a field of unlabeled small bars, and the dashed grey connector between the two zoom panels is the only cross-panel link, easy to miss.

insights.structure: A top row of two pale lavender panels, '(a) End-to-End Training' and '(b) Evaluation', each holding the same Perception trapezoid + Decision box policy; a bottom row of two dashed-outline zoom panels expands Perception (wide, left) and Decision (narrow, right).
insights.data: Expert demonstrations are green cylinders, the point cloud is a real single-view photo then cropped robot points then rainbow height-coloured points, layers are thin vertical colour bars with sizes like (3, 64, 128, 256), and actions are small blue squares a_t^K to a_t^0.
insights.emphasis: The two zoom panels' dashed outlines take the colours of their parents (light cyan for Perception, dark blue for Decision), and dashed wedge lines run from each top-row shape down to its panel.
insights.flow: Top row reads left to right with thick soft-coloured arrows, the evaluation panel closes a loop (Observation up the left, Action down the right to Environment); the bottom row reads left to right, with a grey dashed arrow carrying the Compact 3D Repr. from the Perception panel into the Decision panel.
insights.avoid: The bottom panels carry their own '(a) Point Cloud Processing' / '(b) Compact 3D Representations' sub-labels that clash with the top row's (a)/(b), and the U-Net is a cramped cluster of tiny bars.

arrangement.units: two tinted rounded panels on top (training, evaluation), two dashed zoom panels below for the Perception and Decision modules, each titled in bold at its top
arrangement.inputs_as: green database cylinders for demonstrations; a real point-cloud photo at the left edge of the Perception panel
arrangement.shared: the Perception + Decision pair drawn identically in both top panels; Compact 3D Repr. box passed from the Perception panel into the Decision panel
